packageRules.description: Do not let pinning rewrite .nvmrc to an exact Node patch. Cloudflare Workers Builds can only install the Node versions baked into its build image, so an exact patch pin (e.g. v24.17.0) fails at the tool-install step. Keep .nvmrc at the major (managed by hand).

Soak non-security updates for 7 days so freshly-published (possibly compromised) releases are not ingested immediately. Critical for a password-vault project. Security fixes are exempt: vulnerabilityAlerts sets minimumReleaseAge 0 so they still land immediately.
Auto-merge low-risk updates after the soak window.
Group dev tooling minor/patch updates to reduce PR noise.
Never auto-merge major upgrades; always review them by hand.

jsqr (fallback QR decoder for TOTP setup, used only when the browser has no native BarcodeDetector) has had no release since 2021-04 but declares zero runtime dependencies and ships a prebuilt bundle, so nothing under it can rot: the unabandoned abandoned-exclusions test. A direct CVE is still raised by vulnerabilityAlerts. Revisit if it gains a dependency or an advisory.
